w.ORDER_PROMISE.LATE_one: Order {number} for {customer} is {count} day late: it was promised for {promiseDate}.
w.ORDER_PROMISE.LATE_other: Order {number} for {customer} is {count} days late: it was promised for {promiseDate}.
w.ORDER_PROMISE.AT_RISK_TODAY: Order {number} for {customer} is promised for today ({promiseDate}) and is not ready yet.
w.ORDER_PROMISE.AT_RISK_one: Order {number} for {customer} is promised for tomorrow ({promiseDate}) and is not ready yet.
w.ORDER_PROMISE.AT_RISK_other: Order {number} for {customer} is promised for {promiseDate} (in {count} days) and is not ready yet.
w.WORK_ORDER_HELD.HELD_one: Work order {number} ({style}) cannot be released: {count} check open ({checks}).
w.WORK_ORDER_HELD.HELD_other: Work order {number} ({style}) cannot be released: {count} checks open ({checks}).
w.LOT_HOLD.QUARANTINE: Lot {code} ({item}) waits in quarantine for its release.
w.LOT_HOLD.QUARANTINE.blocks: Its stock cannot be issued to work orders until it is released.
w.LOT_HOLD.BLOCKED_CR_VI: Lot {code} ({item}) is blocked: its chromium VI result failed.
w.LOT_HOLD.BLOCKED.blocks: Its stock stays held: reject the lot, or release it again with new evidence.
w.INVOICE_SDI.REJECTED: Invoice {number} for {customer} was rejected by SDI: correct it and send it again by {deadlineDate}.
w.INVOICE_SDI.REJECTED_NO_DATE: Invoice {number} for {customer} was rejected by SDI: correct it and send it again.
w.INVOICE_SDI.REJECTED.blocks: Until it is sent again it counts as never issued.
w.INVOICE_SDI.ERROR: Invoice {number} for {customer} did not reach SDI: send it again.
w.INVOICE_SDI.ERROR.blocks: The customer has no valid invoice yet.
w.INVOICE_SDI.NOT_DELIVERABLE: SDI could not deliver invoice {number} to {customer}, and no courtesy copy went out.
w.INVOICE_SDI.NOT_DELIVERABLE.blocks: The customer finds it only in their tax area until they get a copy.
w.INVOICE_SDI.FILES_PENDING: Invoice {number} for {customer} is issued, but its XML or PDF is not stored yet.
w.INVOICE_SDI.FILES_PENDING.blocks: It cannot go to SDI without its XML.
w.QUOTE_APPROVAL.PENDING: Quote {number} for {customer} waits for an approval: {reasons}.
w.QUOTE_APPROVAL.blocks: It cannot be sent to the customer until it is decided.
w.PO_PROPOSAL.CHANGES_PROPOSED: {supplier} proposed changes to purchase order {number}: accept or refuse them.
w.PO_PROPOSAL.blocks: Receiving and a new link wait for your answer.
w.PO_NOT_CONFIRMED.DAYS_one: Purchase order {number} to {supplier} is not confirmed {count} day after it was sent.
w.PO_NOT_CONFIRMED.DAYS_other: Purchase order {number} to {supplier} is not confirmed {count} days after it was sent.
w.PO_NOT_CONFIRMED.HOURS_one: Purchase order {number} to {supplier} is not confirmed {count} hour after it was sent.
w.PO_NOT_CONFIRMED.HOURS_other: Purchase order {number} to {supplier} is not confirmed {count} hours after it was sent.
w.SCAN_CORRECTION.PENDING: A correction of the scan of bundle {bundle} at {operation} ({workOrder}) waits for a decision.
w.SCAN_CORRECTION.blocks: {workOrder}'s progress counts the report as it was until the correction is decided.
w.SCAN_REFUSAL.REFUSED: A scan sent from {device} was refused: {message}
w.SCAN_REFUSAL.blocks: {workOrder}'s progress misses it until it is scanned again or discarded.
w.INVOICE_TO_ISSUE.dueLeft_one: The goods left: invoice them ({docType}) by {dueDate}, {count} day left.
w.INVOICE_TO_ISSUE.dueLeft_other: The goods left: invoice them ({docType}) by {dueDate}, {count} days left.
w.INVOICE_TO_ISSUE.dueToday: The goods left: invoice them ({docType}) today, {dueDate}.
w.INVOICE_TO_ISSUE.dueLate_one: The goods left: the invoice ({docType}) was due by {dueDate}, {count} day ago.
w.INVOICE_TO_ISSUE.dueLate_other: The goods left: the invoice ({docType}) was due by {dueDate}, {count} days ago.
w.REGISTER_DUTY.blocks: The entry cannot close until these duties are done (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8).
w.PRIVACY_DUTY.blocksFloor: Floor work that records workers stays off until the worker notice and the DPIA are in place.
w.PRIVACY_DUTY.blocksPeople: People are not told what the system keeps about them.
w.STYLE_COMPLIANCE.BLOCKED: Style {style} is held by its compliance: {complianceChecks}.
w.STYLE_COMPLIANCE.blocks: It holds up the {steps} of open orders (sales orders: {orders}, work orders: {workOrders}).
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.TRIAGE: "{subject}" from {sender} reached no record: sort it.
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.TRIAGE_NO_SUBJECT: Mail from {sender} reached no record: sort it.
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.TRIAGE.blocks: Its sender waits: nobody sees it on a record until it is sorted.
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.HELD.blocks: It reaches no thread until a person releases it or throws it away.
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.FAILED_NO_SUBJECT: Mail from {sender} could not be read.
w.MAIL_TO_SORT.FAILED.blocks: Throw it away, or ask the sender to send it again.
w.NCR_DECISION.WAITING_APPROVAL: NCR {number} waits for the approval of its decision {code} for {quantity}.
w.NCR_DECISION.blocks: It is not carried out, and the NCR is not decided, until another person approves it.

held.review: This row is decided in its review, not here.

actions.acknowledged: Acknowledged. The row stays, marked, while it is as it is.
actions.assigned: Assigned to {name}. It is on their Today.
actions.takenBack: Taken back: the row is nobody's in particular again.
actions.resolved: {record} resolved. It leaves Today for everyone until its condition changes.

problem.changed: This row changed since it was read. Today was read again: look before you decide.
problem.gone: This row is no longer on your Today (someone handled it, or it changed). Today was read again.
problem.invalid: This could not be done as asked (the person may not act on this row, or the note is too short). Today was read again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this on this row.
problem.failed: This could not be sent. Try again.

assign.hint: Only people who may act on this row are listed: its company, the right to act on it, four eyes. The responsible ones first.
assign.nobody: Nobody else may act on this row.
assign.already: It is assigned to this person already.

resolve.title: Resolve {record}
resolve.hint: Kept on the record's history. The alert closes for everyone it went to, and comes back if its condition changes.

empty.title: Nothing handled yet today.
empty.body: What you acknowledge, assign, resolve or approve from Today shows here, for your own record.

arrange.title: Arrange Today
arrange.listHint: Ticked ones show, in this order. Needs me now always shows.
arrange.mainLensHint: Which records the flow strip and My lists open on.
arrange.widthsHint: They apply where My lists spans the page: above Needs me now, or on screens under 1440 pixels. Beside the work, each list takes the column.
arrange.saved: Today is arranged your way. It is saved for you on every device.
arrange.changed: Your arrangement was changed from another window. It was read again: arrange it once more.

snooze.untilChange: Until something changes on the record
snooze.pickFirst: Pick a date and a time first.
snooze.past: Pick a moment later than now.

own.doneMention: Done: the mention on {record}. It leaves Today and your notifications.
own.snoozed: Snoozed: {record}. It comes back at the time you chose.
own.snoozedUntilChange: Snoozed: {record}. It comes back when something changes on it.

ruleAlert.handled: An exception rule raised this alert: acknowledge, assign or resolve it in the alert itself (its own page comes with the alerts screens).

coming.title: Coming up
coming.hint: What lands on you in the next five working days.
coming.error: Couldn't load what is coming up.
coming.empty: Nothing scheduled for you in the next 5 working days.
coming.calendar: Working days of the business calendar.
coming.noCalendar: No calendar picked: Monday to Friday.
coming.partial: A list stopped at its limit: there may be more.

mailToSort.intro: Mail that reached the company's addresses but found no record, mail held until someone looks at it, and mail that could not be read. Assign each one to a record, release it, or throw it away.

all.title: Nothing to sort
all.body: Every mail found its record. New mail that does not shows up here.

TRIAGE.title: No mail without a record
TRIAGE.body: Mail that matches no record and no known sender shows up here.

HELD.title: No held mail
HELD.body: Mail that failed a check or came from an unknown sender is held here for you.

FAILED.title: No unread mail
FAILED.body: Mail that the mail store could not hand over shows up here.

DMARC_FAIL.body: The sender's domain did not pass its DMARC check: the mail may not come from who it says. Release it only if you know it is genuine.

SPAM.body: The mail service marked it as spam. Release it only if you know the sender.

UNKNOWN_SENDER.body: It answers one of our threads, but the sender is not someone that thread knows. Check who wrote before it joins the thread.

THREAD_CLOSED.body: It answers a thread that was closed. Release it to put it in that thread anyway, or assign it to another record.

whyTitle.FAILED: This mail could not be read

why.TRIAGE: Nothing in it names one of our records, and the sender is not a known contact. Assign it to the record it is about, or throw it away.
why.FAILED_one: The mail store could not hand it over after {count} try (it is gone, too large or unreadable). Only its envelope is known: throw it away and ask the sender to write again if it mattered.
why.FAILED_other: The mail store could not hand it over after {count} tries (it is gone, too large or unreadable). Only its envelope is known: throw it away and ask the sender to write again if it mattered.

mailToSort.suggestedBody: The sender writes from the domain of a customer or supplier we know: look among that party's records.

held.noWrite: Writing mail into a record's thread needs another role.
held.reason: Write at least 3 characters, or leave it empty.

pictures.blocked_one: {count} picture from the web is not shown.
pictures.blocked_other: {count} pictures from the web are not shown.
pictures.shown_one: {count} picture from the web is shown.
pictures.shown_other: {count} pictures from the web are shown.

mailToSort.noBodyFailed: The mail could not be read, so there is no text to show.
mailToSort.attachmentsNote: Kept files become the record's files when the mail is assigned or released. Files of other types are never kept.

assign.title: Assign to a record
assign.body: The mail joins the record's thread as a message from the customer or supplier, and its kept files become the record's.
assign.none: No record that can take mail was found. A record needs a customer or supplier for its thread to take mail.
assign.withoutParty_one: {count} record without a customer or supplier is not offered: its thread cannot take mail.
assign.withoutParty_other: {count} records without a customer or supplier are not offered: their threads cannot take mail.
assign.files: Nothing is sent to anyone: the mail and its files only move into the record.
assign.numberHint: Type the number, or part of it.
assign.noMatch: No record with this number can take mail.
assign.moreMatches_one: {count} more: type more of the number.
assign.moreMatches_other: {count} more: type more of the number.

release.title: Release this mail

body.thread: It goes into the thread it answers, as a message from the customer or supplier, with its kept files.
body.list: It goes back to the list as mail without a record: assign it to a record next.

release.risky: It failed a check: release it only if you are sure who sent it.

mailToSort.reasonHint: Kept with the change, for whoever looks later.

reject.title: Throw this mail away
reject.body: It leaves the list. Nothing is deleted and nobody is told.

MARKED_SPAM.title: Spam
MARKED_SPAM.body: Unwanted mail: advertising, phishing, a sender we do not deal with.

DISCARDED.title: Not for us
DISCARDED.body: A real mail that needs no record: a newsletter, an out-of-office reply, a duplicate.

notice.assigned: Assigned. The mail is now a message of the record's thread.
notice.releasedList: Released. It is back in the list, waiting for a record.

rejected.DISCARDED: Thrown away as not for us.

notice.conflict: Someone else, or the mail service, sorted this mail meanwhile. It was read again: check it and try once more.
notice.cannot: The mail cannot go there: the record needs a customer or supplier, or the mail was sorted already. It was read again.
notice.notFound: This mail or that record is no longer here. The list was read again.
notice.forbidden: You may not do this with this mail or this record.
notice.invalid: The answer was refused as it is. Check what you wrote.
notice.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to go on.
notice.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
notice.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Nothing was changed; try again.
notice.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed; try again.

problem.read: The mail could not be read. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: You may not sort mail of this company.
problem.notFound: This mail is no longer here.
problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
